title: Four Questions
summary: Rogue talks V through an extraction of a nervous accountant from a Northside drop house, on foot, in her ear.

start.bringUp: You have an accountant who wants out of a Northside drop house, and you want V to walk him out on foot with your voice in V's ear. Bring up, briefly and in your own way, that you have a job and that you want V to take it.

booth.name: the private booth upstairs at the Afterlife

alley.name: the alley route out of Northside

R3.open.01.text: An accountant. Nervous, hiding in a Northside drop house. He wants out.

R3.open.02.text: Four questions. Reach. Backup. Extraction. What defends the target.

R3.open.03.text: I'll be in your ear. You walk him out. No cars, they get seen.

R3.open.04.text: Cars get seen. Go on foot. Argue after.

R3.stage.recon.01.text: Question one. Reach. How far can they see from the windows?

R3.stage.recon.02.text: Backup. Who's on the stairs? Two? Three?

R3.stage.recon.03.text: Extraction. Pick the route. Alley's short and watched. Roofs are long and empty.

R3.acc.01.text: Please. I can't sleep, I can't think. I'll do whatever you say.

R3.bark.seen.a.text: You're spotted. Don't stop. I'll talk you through.

R3.close.01.text: Nobody saw him. Good. That's the job. Here's your pay.

R3.close.02.text: Good. Keep that list short and keep it real.

g1.asks: Do you take it? And if you want a car, argue it. I'll tell you why you're wrong.
g1.know: You have three routes out of Northside: the alley, the rooftops and the canal road. You stay in the booth, your lines reach V in the ear, and the squad patrols the streets.
g1.secret: You still think of every client as someone's last chance.
g1.wants: V to accept the job, or to argue and be told why you are right.

g2.asks: Fifth question. Who will miss you?
g2.know: The client is inside. Whatever the result was, you ask the fifth question as a rule, and you ask it of yourself too.
g2.secret: You ask it of yourself every night.
g2.wants: V to answer, or to be silent.

stages.label: Rogue briefs the extraction in the booth
stages.know: V is in the Afterlife's private booth upstairs. You sit there and talk V through the four questions. You have a nervous accountant in a Northside drop house, and you want V to walk him out on foot.
stages.wants: V to take the extraction, on foot, with your voice in V's ear.

stages.label: V reaches the Northside drop house
stages.know: V is on the way to the drop house in Northside. You talk V through the four questions over the ear: reach, backup and the route out. The accountant is inside, and he is afraid.
stages.wants: V to answer the questions and pick the way out.

stages.label: V walks the accountant to the Afterlife side door
stages.know: The accountant follows V on foot. Six contractors patrol the alley route. You are in V's ear, and you want the client alive at the side door. If the contractors spot V, the walk becomes a fight.
stages.wants: The client alive at the Afterlife side door, and V unseen if possible.

stages.label: Rogue pays and asks the fifth question
stages.know: The client went through the side door unseen. You pay V, and you have the fifth question ready. You ask it as a rule, not as a joke.
stages.wants: V to answer the fifth question, or to be silent.

stages.label: Rogue pays and asks the fifth question, after a fight
stages.know: The client came out alive, after a fight. You pay V, and you have the fifth question ready. You ask it as a rule, not as a joke.
stages.wants: V to answer the fifth question, or to be silent.

clean.memory: You got a nervous accountant out of Northside unseen, on a route Rogue's four questions picked.

loud.memory: You got a nervous accountant out of Northside after a fight, and he is alive.

lost-client.memory: You brought back the story but not the man, and Rogue did not blame you.

car.memory: You argued for a car against Rogue's orders and went by car anyway, and she said nothing.

no.memory: You said no to Rogue's extraction, and she did it another way.
